description: This source file is a script for analyzing TypeScript plugin files within a repository to ensure import boundaries are respected, particularly related to bundled plugin extensions. It includes functions to collect inventory data on plugin imports, check for violations, compare against expected baseline data, and generate human-readable reports.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two inventory entries to determine sorting order based on file, line number, kind, specifier, and reason.

methods.name: classifyResolvedExtensionReason
methods.description: Classifies resolved extension paths to determine the reason for import boundary violations, such as re-exports, dynamic imports, or direct imports, with distinctions for source plugin implementation, entrypoints, or owned files.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Adds an inventory entry into the entries array.

methods.name: scanImportBoundaryViolations
methods.description: Scans a source file for module specifiers that violate extension import boundaries, resolving paths and classifying reasons.

methods.name: scanWebSearchRegistrySmells
methods.description: Detects potential registry smell issues related to web search providers in specific source files.

methods.name: shouldSkipFile
methods.description: Determines whether a file should be skipped during inventory collection based on path and filename patterns.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects an inventory of plugin extension import boundary violations across specific source roots, with caching.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory JSON file, with caching.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Diffs the expected and actual inventories to identify violations.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Generates a human-readable report of the inventory, listing violations by file and line.

methods.name: formatEntry
methods.description: Formats a single inventory entry into a summary string.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the baseline inventory check, comparing actual collected data against expected inventory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for script execution, running the import boundary check and optionally exiting with code.
